name: Pedestal
_about: A PEDESTAL and the statue on it, as the classical writers proportion one: its height in three -- the BASE (a plinth and the moulding over it, a quarter), the DIE (the plain block the inscription is cut in, three fifths) and the CORNICE (its bed moulding and the slab that sheds the rain, the rest) -- the base and the cornice standing out round the die, the cornice furthest. The die is `W` by `L`; the statue stands in the middle of the cornice, facing +z unless turned.

params._H: the pedestal's whole height, plinth to cornice top
params._out: how far the plinth stands out round the die; the cornice stands out a third more
params._scale: the figure against a person: a statue a little over life, on a pedestal a little under its own height
params._face: the figure's turn: -90 degrees faces it down +z, the way the pedestal is set (a statue's own front is its +x)
